title: Show actionable readiness instead of exposing control recovery machinery
outcome: TermAl tells the operator whether a session is ready, recovering, or needs an action, with technical control/evaluation details available on demand.
acceptance: Default session/settings UI shows understandable readiness and a concrete action on failure; raw recovery flags, evidence bases and evaluator internals move to optional diagnostics rather than blocking comprehension.

Tests distinguish idle lazy recovery, in-progress recovery, successful binding and failed recovery; clearing pending alone never displays successful admission, and blocked control never enables provider dispatch.
